say:1:1710333001:1.text: Good to see you both, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gwyneth! Do you... have any updates about Peggy?
say:1:1710333001:1.male: Good to see you both, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gwyneth! Do you... have any updates about Peggy?
say:1:1710333001:1.female: Good to see you both, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gwyneth! Do you... have any updates about Peggy?

say:3:1710333002:1.text: Sorry... we're still looking into the matter.
say:3:1710333002:1.source_cn: 抱歉……暂时还没有。我们仍在全力调查。

say:4:1710333003:1.text: This is so frustrating! I've mobilized all the Consortium members and put up a bounty for informants...
say:4:1710333003:1.source_cn: 可恶！我已经动员了商会成员加以打听，还悬赏了有关圣古堂...

say:5:1710333004:1.text: But so far, I've heard nothing back...

say:6:1710333005:1.text: Who could possibly know about something this bizarre?
say:6:1710333005:1.source_cn: 圣古堂消失这种事，简直无从查起……

say:7:1710333006:1.text: Peggy... she might seem tough, but it's because she only cries when she's alone...
say:7:1710333006:1.source_cn: 佩吉……那个家伙，总是装出一副什么都不怕的样子，但其实...

choice_prompt:8:1710333006.text: Peggy... she might seem tough, but it's because she only cries when she's alone...
choice_prompt:8:1710333006.source_cn: 佩吉……那个家伙，总是装出一副什么都不怕的样子，但其实在别人看不见的地方，她也经常哭鼻子……

say:9:1710333008:1.text: Keep your cool, Rowan! Right now, our priority is finding more leads.
say:9:1710333008:1.source_cn: 罗万，你冷静点！我们现在需要的是线索。

say:10:1710333009:1.text: As the <style="highlight">Mithril Consortium's</style> Young Master, you have access to insider news that we don't.

say:11:1710333010:1.text: So, we need to pick your brain—can you think of anyone who might want to hurt Peggy?
say:11:1710333010:1.source_cn: 你想一想，有没有什么人，可能会对佩吉不利？

say:13:1710333012:1.text: The King's health is failing, and almost all the nobles are aware of it.
say:13:1710333012:1.source_cn: 国王陛下的病情日益沉重，这个消息在贵族圈子里已经不是秘密了。

say:14:1710333013:1.text: Meanwhile, His Majesty's decision to appoint the Queen as regent has drawn much criticism from them.
say:14:1710333013:1.source_cn: 而国王陛下让王后陛下代为摄政，也招来了许多贵族的非议与不满。

choice_prompt:15:1710333013.text: Meanwhile, His Majesty's decision to appoint the Queen as regent has drawn much criticism from them.
choice_prompt:15:1710333013.source_cn: 而国王陛下让王后陛下代为摄政，也招来了许多贵族的非议与不满。

say:16:1710333014:1.text: I can't say for sure... These sentiments have been simmering for quite some time, but no one has acted on them...
say:16:1710333014:1.source_cn: 未必……尽管这些情绪已经酝酿发酵了许久，但都停留在口头上。

say:17:1710333015:1.text: Honestly, I can't picture any of those people having the nerve to lay a hand on Peggy.
say:17:1710333015:1.source_cn: 我实在想象不出来那些人里面……谁敢真的对佩吉出手。

say:18:1710333016:1.text: Which means we don't have a definite suspect.
say:18:1710333016:1.source_cn: 没有具体的怀疑对象啊。

say:19:1710333017:1.text: A young woman in a Mithril Consortium uniform hurriedly approaches and tries to get Rowan's attention.
say:19:1710333017:1.source_cn: 此时，一位身着秘银制服的年轻女性快步走了过来，试图跟你...
say:19:1710333017:1.male: A young woman in a Mithril Consortium uniform hurriedly approaches and tries to get Rowan's attention.
say:19:1710333017:1.female: A young woman in a Mithril Consortium uniform hurriedly approaches and tries to get Rowan's attention.

say:22:1710333019:1.text: Could it be someone from the <style="highlight">Hastings family</style>? They're the conservative type and the loudest in opposing the Queen's regency.

say:23:1710333020:1.text: But do any of them have the ability to make the Hall of Ancients vanish into thin air?
say:23:1710333020:1.source_cn: 可那些人会有能让圣古堂凭空消失的本领吗？

say:25:1710333022:1.text: Hannah, please... I'm discussing something important with <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gwyneth.
say:25:1710333022:1.male: Hannah, please... I'm discussing something important with <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gwyneth.
say:25:1710333022:1.female: Hannah, please... I'm discussing something important with <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gwyneth.

say:26:1710333023:1.text: I-I know this is a bad time to intrude, but...
say:26:1710333023:1.source_cn: 我、我知道不该在这个时候打扰您的，罗万少爷……

say:27:1710333024:1.text: The factory just won't stop asking for the final designs of our new products.
say:27:1710333024:1.source_cn: 但是……新一季产品的最终设计方案，工厂那边在催了。

say:28:1710333025:1.text: The entire production line will halt if we don't give our confirmation soon.
say:28:1710333025:1.source_cn: 如果现在不进行确认，整个生产线就要停工了。

say:29:1710333026:1.text: ... Why does it have to be now?!

choice_prompt:30:1710333026.text: ... Why does it have to be now?!

say:31:1710333027:1.text: For now, there are no other leads we can follow anyway.
say:31:1710333027:1.source_cn: 眼下佩吉的事，我们确实还没有更有价值的线索。

say:32:1710333028:1.text: Go ahead and handle your business. We'll be waiting for you here.
say:32:1710333028:1.source_cn: 你先去忙生意吧，我们会在这里等你。你处理好了之后，我们...

say:33:1710333029:1.text: But I'm so worried about her! Ugh!

say:34:1710333030:1.text: Please wait for me. I'll be back in a jiffy!
say:34:1710333030:1.source_cn: 你们稍等一下，我处理完这件事马上回来！

choice:30:0:1.text: Go ahead. Your business is important too.
choice:30:0:1.male: Go ahead. Your business is important too.
choice:30:0:1.female: Go ahead. Your business is important too.

choice:15:0:1.text: Could this be a plot against the Queen?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 所以这其实是冲着王后去的？
choice:15:0:1.male: Could this be a plot against the Queen?
choice:15:0:1.female: Could this be a plot against the Queen?

choice:8:0:1.text: We won't let anything happen to her.
choice:8:0:1.male: We won't let anything happen to her.
choice:8:0:1.female: We won't let anything happen to her.

choice:8:2:3.text: I'm surprised you're so worried about her.
choice:8:2:3.male: I'm surprised you're so worried about her.
choice:8:2:3.female: I'm surprised you're so worried about her.
